pitchEn: Flock Drift is a gentle steering game: guide your migrating flock of birds through drifting wind, dunes and night skies while keeping the formation together. Lead the V-formation, ride tailwinds, dodge predators and rocks and gather stragglers before they fall behind, across a series of hand-tuned migration levels. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
newFeaturesEn: First release of Flock Drift: a canvas-2D flock-steering game where you lead a migrating flock through wind, dunes, night skies, predators and obstacles across hand-tuned levels, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, use the on-screen direction pads to steer your flock: lead the birds toward the destination, keep the formation together, and avoid predators and obstacles to clear each level. No account, login, or internet connection is required.
